title: D1SeamContractsRegistry
description: Local/static AC-0.5 and AC-0.10 registry for D1 shape-invariant seam contracts. It validates A2a mutation payload/result and A2b workflow-to-AI-step invocation signature files without claiming live cloud-ci authority or Phase-0 completion.

_meta.source_request: Founder directives: keep Phase-0 honest, Buck2-native, Rust-first, modern, hyperscaler-oriented, and suitable; do not add Tarpaulin or new oya CLI authority.

official_references.name: Protocol Buffers — Proto3 Language Guide
official_references.used_for: Records syntax = proto3 and optional scalar field shape for consistency_token.

official_references.name: Protocol Buffers — Field Presence
official_references.used_for: Records explicit presence as the Phase-0 reason to keep the wire field proto-optional while gate fixtures require token presence.

official_references.name: Buck2 — Commands
official_references.used_for: Records Buck2 target execution as local/static gate evidence and Build ID source.

official_references.name: Rustc Book — Instrumentation-based Code Coverage
official_references.used_for: Keeps modern Rust coverage direction aligned to Buck2-native LLVM source-based coverage rather than Tarpaulin.

claim_boundary.note: Fixture-backed local/static D1 seam contract evidence only. This gate does not run live D1 conformance, post statuses, mutate branch protection, prove P0.0 green, prove Phase-0 completion, prove production readiness, or prove hyperscaler-grade readiness.

required_shape_invariants: MutationResult carries optional string consistency_token and Phase-0 fixtures must provide it
A2b request carries typed tool ref, args_json, Cedar principal, idempotency key, and D1 conformance reference
execution_locality/outbox/saga topology fields are present but conformance-gated and not frozen until AC-0.10b Phase-2 GREEN

modern_rust_standards_record.coverage_noncanonical_surface: Tarpaulin is not the canonical coverage surface
modern_rust_standards_record.mutation_local_ergonomics: Dual Cargo.toml + Buck2/Reindeer setup keeps local Cargo mutation testing advisory for developer feedback while Buck2/cloud-ci captured evidence remains merge authority.
modern_rust_standards_record.hyperscaler_orientation: The gate is deterministic, target-addressable, fixture-backed, protocol-versioned, tenant/principal-aware, idempotency-keyed, Cedar-principal-aware, and suitable for trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci promotion.

d1_conformance_reference.claim_boundary: This AC-0.5 gate references the D1 read-your-writes conformance path but does not execute or green it.
